text.offer: The avar warriors answer to their chieftains, and the chieftains answer to no one. Strike at them and the war turns. Five chieftains - it will not be easy, and you may want friends at your back.
text.progress: The avar chieftains lead the camps of the warrior and noble avars, deep in the jungle.
text.complete: Five chieftains. In all my years of this war I have not seen the like. Ko'catan is in your debt.
